import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int P = 998244353;
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int B = 1000000;
    static long n, cnt;
    static long[] s = new long[7];
    static int ans;
    static List<Integer>[] p = new ArrayList[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            p[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int m(long d) {
        long res = (d % P + P) % P;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static void dfs0(int d, long v) {
        cnt++;
        p[d].add(m(cnt - v));
        if (d < 6) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                dfs0(d + 1, v * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int calc(int id, int f) {
        List<Integer> list = p[id];
        int ps = lowerBound(list, P - f);
        long res = ((long)f * list.size() + s[id] - (long)P * (list.size() - ps)) % mod;
        if (res < 0) res += mod;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    static void dfs1(int d, long v) {
        if (v > n) return;
        if (d >= 1) {
            if (v * B > n / 10 && v * B + B - 1 <= n) {
                int t = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                    ans = (ans + calc(i, m(cnt - v * t))) % mod;
                    t *= 10;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                    cnt += p[i].size();
                }
                return;
            }
            ans = (ans + m(++cnt - v)) % mod;
        }
        int start = d == 0 ? 0 : 0; // in C++ code, !d is used, so start from 0
        for (int i = start; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(d + 1, v * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        dfs0(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(p[i]);
            for (int val : p[i]) {
                s[i] += val;
            }
        }
        cnt = 0;
        ans = 0;
        dfs1(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
